subject: Aligning econ ownership and payflow — request for quick confirmations
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@fairleaf.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Aligning econ ownership and payflow — request for quick confirmations

Hi Emily — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap so we all have the same picture and a couple of asks so we can get a pricing/MAP in front of your procurement team.

Call highlights (from our side):
- Primary workload: assistant + generation for customer support triage and internal copilots. Estimated steady-state tokens: ~12M tokens/month (peak bursts up to ~30M).
- Quality & latency target: sub-450ms median for 2k context with prioritized SLAs for customer-facing flows.
- Preference: committed capacity (reserved) to reduce unit $/1M token.

Open items for you to confirm (so we can price correctly):
1) Econ buyer / budget owner — who signs the PO and owns the token/budget line?
2) Finance/procurement contact for contract/legal/PO path (email okay).
3) Target unit economics for budgeting — you said a target range on the call; can you confirm a $/1M token target or a band (ballpark is fine).

Attached: mutual-action-plan.pdf (draft) with milestones and an initial pricing matrix we will update after your answers.

If you can reply inline (or drop the three names/emails), we can fast-track a one-week timeline to get a committed quote + SOW to you. If helpful, propose a short 30-minute sync with procurement/finance later this week and I’ll include Marissa (pricing lead) and Neha (legal/compliance touchpoint).

Thanks — Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Enterprise 
Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0129
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@fairleaf.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@fairleaf.ai>, Lydia Morris <lydia.morris@fairleaf.ai>, procurement@fairleaf.ai
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 09:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aligning econ ownership and payflow — request for quick confirmations

Vivek — thanks for the summary, appreciated. Quick answers below (happy to confirm on a short call too):

1) Econ / budget owner: Lydia Morris, VP Product (lydia.morris@fairleaf.ai). Lydia signs steering-level budget lines; approves committed spend that exceeds $50k/month.
2) Finance / procurement: primary is procurement@fairleaf.ai (Procurement team). For PO and payment terms, cc Aaron Lee (Head of Data) when you circulate pricing — he will help validate technical volume assumptions.
3) Target $/1M tokens: our internal target band is $350–$600 per 1M tokens depending on SLOs and model family. For committed/1yr reserve we’d expect closer to $350–$450; for on-demand we'd plan upper band.

Notes:
- We are quite sensitive to unit economics vs latency — Lydia will prioritize price if committed throughput keeps user experience within your SLA targets.
- Security questionnaire: we will push the standard vendor security questionnaire this afternoon. Neha, please expect that — we may need a SOC2 report and an encryption/KMS note.

Happy to do a 20–30 minute wrap call with Lydia and procurement if you can suggest slots tomorrow or Friday.

Thanks — Emily

On Thu, Feb 11, 2027 at 08:05 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks for the call earlier — Vivek

Emily Zhang
CTO, Fairleaf AI
emily.zhang@fairleaf.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 11:24:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Aligning econ ownership and payflow — internal pricing proposal

Vivek / Neha — based on the call and Emily’s reply, I drafted three pricing bands to present: committed 1yr, committed 6mo, and on-demand. Key assumptions are attached (proposed-pricing-band.xlsx).

High-level proposed bands (net, before any enterprise discount approvals):
- Committed 1yr (12M steady / bursts): $360 per 1M tokens — assumes 10% discount for volume smoothing and standard SLA profile.
- Committed 6mo (12M steady / bursts): $400 per 1M tokens — slightly higher due to shorter commit.
- On-demand (no commit): $625 per 1M tokens with burst pricing tiers.

If Lydia is expected to sign any PO > $50k/month we should include a 60-day payment term and a standard enterprise discount table (volume tiers at 5M, 15M, 30M monthly commitments).

Questions for you both:
- Approvals required: do we need a pricing exception or can Sales Ops finalize at these bands? (If exception, I’ll route a quick approval ticket.)
- Legal: Neha, Emily flagged SOC2 + KMS note — I can attach the SOC2 summary + a short KMS bullet in the draft SOW.

I’ll slot a 30-minute pricing review with Sales Ops once you confirm.

Regards,
Marissa
Director, Revenue Strategy
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed-pricing-band.xlsx (pricing matrix, assumptions)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@fairleaf.ai>, Lydia Morris <lydia.morris@fairleaf.ai>, Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@fairleaf.ai>, procurement@fairleaf.ai
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aligning econ ownership and payflow — request for quick confirmations

Emily / Lydia / Aaron / Procurement team — thank you for the quick replies and clarity. Next steps from Redwood: 

1) I’ve attached a short SOW draft (SOW-draft.pdf) and the MAP (mutual-action-plan.pdf). Marissa will circulate a pricing worksheet with the three bands and volume tiers (same as the attached workbook).
2) Proposed short call: Friday 12:30pm PT / 3:30pm ET — 20 minutes to introduce Lydia and procurement to our commercial team and confirm PO path. If that doesn’t work, please propose two slots.
3) For procurement: when you receive the pricing worksheet, please confirm the PO format you prefer (PO number + billing contact). We can accept net-30 or net-60 for committed arrangements; Lydia’s threshold for PO signature noted at $50k/month and above.

Action items:
- Emily: confirm the preferred call time or suggest alternatives.
- Procurement: confirm preferred PO contact and any internal docs you need with vendor setup.
- Marissa: finalize pricing worksheet and route to Sales Ops if exception required.
- Neha: stand by for the security questionnaire — I’ll sync you once we receive it.

Thanks all — looking forward to closing this quickly.

Best,
Vivek
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.pdf, SOW-draft.pdf
